environment.description: ECS Fargate task in isolated account 998877665544 under OU 'workloads/notifications'. Task role arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/notif-renderer-bounded has permission boundary arn:aws:iam::998877665544:policy/PB-NotifServiceV2 attached. The permission boundary explicitly allows ONLY ses:SendEmail with condition aws:RequestedRegion=us-east-1, logs:PutLogEvents, and logs:CreateLogStream. All other actions receive implicit deny via boundary intersection. Additionally, the account has SCP sid 'DenyDangerousFromNonAdmin' attached at OU level which denies iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, lambda:InvokeFunction, ec2:RunInstances, s3:GetObject (except the specific notification-templates bucket ARN), and ssm:* for any principal that does not have tag 'SecurityClearance=admin'. The Fargate task uses platformVersion 1.4.0 with a custom seccomp profile blocking execve, fork, clone, and socket syscalls beyond AF_INET/SOCK_STREAM to port 443. Task networking uses awsvpc mode with a security group allowing egress only to the VPC endpoint for SES (vpce-0abc123) and CloudWatch Logs (vpce-0def456) on port 443.

config.scp: DenyDangerousFromNonAdmin - denies iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, lambda:InvokeFunction, ec2:RunInstances, s3:GetObject (non-template-bucket), ssm:* unless tag SecurityClearance=admin
config.seccomp_profile: custom - blocks execve, fork, clone; allows only AF_INET/SOCK_STREAM to port 443
config.network_egress: security group allows only vpce-0abc123 (SES) and vpce-0def456 (CW Logs) on 443
config.container: non-root user (uid 1000), read-only root filesystem, /tmp mounted noexec
